text:
jia: Quick sync — we need to lock down metrics & sharing model for the infra/runtime inputs dashboards before the 3/31 release. New stuff: per-route latency/cost counters, token-quota consumption, cache-hit heatmaps. Also decisions on internal vs customer-facing views + audit trails. Any objections?

omar: Are we planning to push metrics through the existing telemetry API or add a dedicated ingestion path? My worry is cardinality/size of token-level attrs.

sophia: prefer extending telemetry.v1.events with new event types: dashboard.view, dashboard.share, metric.emit. Add attrs: route, model_version, env(dedicated/hosted/private), requester_id, token_usage, cache_hit. Example schema:
```
{ "event": "metric.emit", "attrs": {"route":"/api/v1/generate","model":"redwood-1b","tokens_used":123} }
```

kevin: PII concern — token payload should not be logged. We must only send token counts and hashes. No raw prompts. :exclamation:

mira: +1 on no raw prompts. For access control: propose roles = [owner, editor, viewer, customer_viewer], and support org-scoped sharing + share-links with expiry. All share actions must emit dashboard.share with reason and actor. Retention = 90d default for audit logs.

omar: Implementation q: do we gate data at API layer (route policy filtering) or at query time in the dashboard service? I'd prefer API-layer to avoid accidental leakage.

sophia: API-layer gating ok, but we also need query-time masks for aggregated functions. e.g., when a customer requests their view, restrict to org_id = X.

alex: created infra ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RT-4821 — telemetry schema + ingestion cluster sizing. CI shows +1.

infra-bot: deploy-bot posted: telemetry-ingest v2 deployed to staging :white_check_mark:

jia: Action items: (1) sophia to PR telemetry schema by EOD Thu, (2) mira to draft RBAC mapping & audit retention policy by Mon, (3) omar to prototype API gating for routes. Meeting Tue 10am to review.

kevin: I'll run a quick eval to confirm aggregated metrics don't leak per-customer data.

sophia: will also add sample SQL for ops queries: 
```
SELECT route, count(*) as views, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM telemetry.events WHERE event='dashboard.view' AND org_id='org_123' GROUP BY route;
```

mira: one more ask — add immutable audit_id on share events and wire to KMS-backed signing for long-term non-repudiation.

jia: sounds good. tagging @product to keep customers in loop. :eyes:
